    Draw a Two-Stage Cluster Sample of Households

    draw_cluster_sample.Rd

    This function performs two-stage cluster sampling within counties. In the first stage, a specified number of unique villages are selected randomly. In the second stage, a fixed number of households are randomly drawn from each of those selected villages. Both target sizes are pulled from the allocation frame.

    draw_cluster_sample(
  data,
  county_var = "county",
  village_id_var = "village",
  allocation_df,
  alloc_villages_var = "target_villages",
  alloc_hh_var = "target_hh_per_village",
  seed = 42
)

    Arguments

    data

    A data frame containing raw household-level records.

    county_var

    The bare or quoted column name identifying the county stratum.

    village_id_var

    The bare or quoted column name identifying the unique village.

    allocation_df

    A data frame containing columns for the county identifier, the target village sample size, and the target household sample size per village.

    alloc_villages_var

    The bare or quoted column name in allocation_df indicating the number of villages to sample per county.

    alloc_hh_var

    The bare or quoted column name in allocation_df indicating the number of households to sample per chosen village.

    seed

    An integer value used to initialize the pseudo-random number generator for reproducible sampling. Defaults to 42.

    Value

    A data frame containing the cluster-sampled household rows.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# dummy raw household data
raw_households <- data.frame(
  county_id = rep(c("County_A", "County_B"), each = 15),
  village_id = c(rep("V1", 5), rep("V2", 5), rep("V3", 5), 
                 rep("V4", 5), rep("V5", 5), rep("V6", 5)),
  household_id = paste0("HH_", 1:30)
)

# multi-stage target allocations dataframe
cluster_allocations <- data.frame(
  county_id = c("County_A", "County_B"),
  target_villages = c(2, 2),
  target_hh_per_village = c(3, 2)
)

# run dynamic cluster sampling
cluster_sample <- draw_cluster_sample(
  data = raw_households,
  county_var = "county_id",
  village_id_var = "village_id",
  allocation_df = cluster_allocations,
  alloc_villages_var = "target_villages",
  alloc_hh_var = "target_hh_per_village",
  seed = 42
)
} # }
